source_text.body:
Book a pet-friendly hotel with a browser agent
A reviewer asked Comet to book a hotel with specific criteria like pet-friendly rooms, but it couldn't connect to booking sites and stumbled on complex tasks.
Done with
PC
Perplexity Comet
What they did
The reviewer tested Perplexity's Comet browser on a hotel booking request with specific criteria, including pet-friendly rooms. The source gives no more detail on the prompt or the steps. In a separate test, Comet found women's boots and tried to check out on its own.
How it went
The hotel task failed. Comet said it couldn't connect to booking websites. The boots test worked until checkout, where it kept hitting errors. The review calls the hotel gap a critical one for trip planning.
Worth knowing
Don't count on Comet to finish bookings or checkouts. It did better at researching and shortlisting products than at completing transactions.
Try it yourself
with
Perplexity Comet
Copy prompt
Find me a pet-friendly hotel in [city] for [check-in date] to [check-out date], for [number] guests and a [dog/cat/other pet]. My criteria are: [budget per night], [neighborhood or distance to a landmark], and [must-have amenities]. Give me the 3 best options with price, pet policy and fees, and a direct booking link for each. Stop before entering any payment details or submitting a booking, and show me what you are about to book first.
Original source: https://www.emarketer.com/content/review-comet-browser-turns-ai-tool-shopping-site-navigation
